demos.title: How a rate limit really works
demos.summary: Ten requests get through a limit of five: a token bucket on random traffic, the bucket in code, and a fixed window against a sliding window on the same burst.
demos.note: The traffic is a real simulator run (seed 42 and 1), not a drawing.
demos.prompt: Explain how a rate limit really works, with a real simulation.

demos.title: What aisle add does
demos.summary: One step per line of Agent Aisle's own source, drawn from an architecture model of the install path.
demos.note: Every step cites a file and line from the model.
demos.prompt: Show what aisle add does, step by step, from our own code.

demos.title: A tour of the code
demos.summary: The same install path as a narrated tour, built straight from the architecture model.
demos.note: Only the aisle add flow, not the whole repository.
demos.prompt: Give me a narrated tour of how aisle add works in this repo.

demos.title: This week in npm downloads
demos.summary: A chart video from three real npm download counts, fetched on the day, with the source and date on screen.
demos.note: Numbers are as the npm API returned them; two big jumps are unchecked against another source.
demos.prompt: Make a chart video of this week's npm downloads for commander, zod and tsup.

demos.title: A checkout slowdown
demos.summary: An animated timeline of an outage with the minutes between events computed from the times.
demos.prompt: Make an incident replay video from this postmortem.

demos.title: video-core 0.6.0
demos.summary: A what-changed video from a real diff of this repository, with every number counted from the diff.
demos.prompt: Make a what-changed video for this diff.

demos.title: Agent Aisle, from its README
demos.summary: Every spoken line is a sentence from the README, and every fact cites its line.
demos.prompt: Turn our README into a short video.

demos.title: Nour learns to share
demos.summary: A short cartoon for ages 3 to 5 with two original puppet characters and a learning goal.
demos.note: The voices are adult voices pitch-shifted to sound younger, not real children.
demos.prompt: A cartoon for kids aged 3 to 5 about sharing, with two original characters.

demos.title: Nour learns to share (3D)
demos.summary: The same story with the optional lit, clay-style 3D look.
demos.note: Same voices as the flat version.
demos.prompt: The same kids cartoon in a lit 3D look.

demos.title: Dot tries again
demos.summary: A character traced from a drawing (here a synthetic one, not a child's) is rigged and stars in a story about trying again.
demos.note: The drawing is synthetic; tracing a real crayon drawing gives a cruder result.
demos.prompt: Make my child's drawing into a character and tell a story about trying again.

demos.title: Arabic proverbs
demos.summary: Three Arabic proverbs set as kinetic lettering, uncovered a word at a time with the letters joined by the browser.
demos.note: The translations are an unreviewed draft: a native reader should check them.
demos.prompt: Animate these Arabic proverbs as kinetic lettering.

coming.title: Story from stills
coming.why: Needs an image provider you pay for: the skill prints a price and stops until you approve that exact total.

coming.title: Product demo of your own app
coming.why: Needs Playwright to record your app, which is not set up on the machine that made these demos.

coming.title: Edit your own footage
coming.why: Works on your clips (trim, captions, loudness, reframe); no sample footage is shipped.
